text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I was totally useless...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There's no use moping around...
Even when I tell myself to switch gears,
I can only think about my lack of follow-through and regrets...
choice_data_list: You can be proud of a run where you never gave up till the end.
Let's use this frustration to do our best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! ...You're right.
Not everything about today's race is a regret.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
True, this may be my current limit, but
I held strong in my heart right until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I really don't want to give up...!
Even if it didn't work out this time, next time for sure!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll work much, much harder!
I won't just hold regrets, I'll make the most of today's experience!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. Moping around won't make my dreams come true."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"My father was a sumo wrestler, and no matter how many times he lost,
he never skipped practice."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Keeping your head up and looking straight ahead...
It's truly amazing how your spirit never breaks!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I won't give up either! I'll do my best
with the mindset that next time will be the one...!"
